Sandy beach with lots of water Pals around.
Not many trees, but many Pals call this place home.

TextData.SourceString:
Coastline with reefs in every direction.
Average number of resources and Pals.
Though rocky, it's easy enough to secure a wide, open plot of land.

TextData.SourceString:
A sunny island blessed with a pleasant sea breeze.
Near a volcano with a warm, easy-to-live in climate.
With good access to the surrounding islands, it's a great place for setting off on adventures.

TextData.SourceString:
An island devoid of any signs of human life.
Its lack of greenery makes settling there far from ideal.

TextData.SourceString:
A restful island with peaks and valleys surrounded by sprawling forests.
Because its resources and Pals are in limited supply, not many people set their roots here.

TextData.SourceString:
Wild island to the east.
At the edge of the main island, none have considered developing it.
Those not used to living in the wilds would find it hard to survive here.

An island with sprawling wetlands.
The ample moisture allows for berries to grow in abundance and wide variety of Pal inhabitants.​
